question: What form of the auspicious goddess is to be meditated upon in the six centers?
premises: Meditation is performed in the six centers.
The object of meditation is the goddess.
The goddess is world-filled and auspicious.
inference: One should meditate in the six centers on the auspicious goddess who is filled with the world.
plain_english: O Supreme Goddess, having meditated in the six centers, contemplate the auspicious goddess who is filled with the world.
